## Rooms

- Deluxe: 12 rooms; 2 adults + 1 child; single occupancy from ₹3,500.
- Super Deluxe: 10 rooms; 3 adults + 1 child; ₹500 category increment.
- Executive: 12 rooms; 4 adults + 1 child; ₹500 category increment.
- Double occupancy adds ₹500.
- EP, CP, MAP and AP meal plans are available. Contact the hotel for meal-plan pricing and current availability.
